title: 阪神JFの後に・自分の意志で

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold City finishes the Hanshin J.F. to roaring cheers from the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She hears them call her "pretty" and "beautiful." Having failed to change their perspective, she grows irritated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They want to see her win the Triple Tiara not to celebrate her running, but for the pretty picture. Pandering to that would make her a doll with no agency.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wanting to decide her own path, she chooses to run for the Classic Triple Crown. First up will be the Satsuki Sho!
